short: Logical spacetime bound for one 333-qubit run

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.p450GroundEnergy_const_cost
lean.plain: Worst-case T count and logical spacetime bound
lean.annotation: `.count PrimitiveGate.TOFF = 0` excludes uncompiled Toffolis, which would contribute zero to the T count. The compiled temporary AND uses four T gates to compute and zero T gates to uncompute by measurement and Clifford correction. A conditional contributes the larger branch count.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.p450GroundEnergyConstCost
lean.annotation: The Lean bound is $333\times1{,}310{,}839{,}337=436{,}509{,}499{,}221$ qubit–T. Appendix I.2 calculates the numerator from 481 qubits, 49,056 steps and $4\times11{,}517=46{,}068$ T gates per step. Dividing gives about 2.49025.

lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.P450GroundEnergy.Solution.SevenGearWalk333.fast7gProg_const_cost
lean.plain: T-count bounds for the walk and phase estimation
lean.annotation: The block-cost proof uses `tM = 3,980,180` T for a 128-step block, `t4B = 0` for the unused slot, and `tF = 37,642` T for a final single step. It supplies `tTot = 1,310,839,337` to establish the full-program bound of 436,509,499,221 qubit–T at width 333; a separate conjunct excludes primitive Toffolis.

lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.P450GroundEnergy.Solution.SevenGearWalk333.mainAncillas
lean.annotation: The 217 ancillas comprise 16 phase-estimation qubits, 11 phase-gradient qubits, 17 and 24 for state preparation, and 149 workspace qubits. The first eight blocks borrow 11 unprepared phase bits, giving 160 workspace qubits within the same width of 333.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.p450GroundEnergy_correctness
lean.plain: Energy error of the compiled circuit
lean.annotation: The paper reports 333 logical qubits and 1,310,839,337 T gates. In `p450GroundEnergy_correctness`, the same unitary witness `W` satisfies the decoded low-energy error predicate and is realized by the compiled `p450GroundEnergyProgram` with initially zero workspace; `Finset.univ` selects all system basis labels for the realization condition.

statements.note: The P450 row reports 333 logical qubits and 1,310,839,337 T gates for the energy-estimation circuit, giving 436,509,499,221 qubit–T. The 2.49-fold reduction is the manuscript's comparison with its baseline estimate, not a resource-theorem conclusion.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.p450GroundEnergy_const_cost
lean.plain: Worst-case T count and logical spacetime bound
lean.annotation: The first conjunct gives zero primitive Toffolis. The second bounds peak logical width times worst-branch T count. The width includes all $116+217$ wires, even when part of the workspace is idle.
